python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img30 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0030.png')
# Camera at (-0.5, 3.3), heading 0 (+y).
# Plant 1 pot is right in the center!
mask_pot = (img30[:,:,2] > 100) & (img30[:,:,1] > 40) & (img30[:,:,1] < 90) & (img30[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 150) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 350)
ys_p, xs_p = np.where(mask_pot)
print('obs 30 Plant 1 pot: x in [', xs_p.min(), xs_p.max(), '], y in [', ys_p.min(), ys_p.max(), '], bottom y =', ys_p.max())
d_p1_30 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys_p.max() - 255.5)
print(f'Plant 1 dist in obs 30: {d_p1_30:.2f} m')
x_p1 = -0.5 + (xs_p.mean() - 255.5)/256 * d_p1_30
y_p1 = 3.3 + d_p1_30
print(f'Plant 1 world coords: x = {x_p1:.2f}, y = {y_p1:.2f}')

# Chair on the left (Chair 1):
mask_c1 = (img30[:,:,2] > 80) & (img30[:,:,2] < 150) & (img30[:,:,1] > 35) & (img30[:,:,1] < 80) & (img30[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 150)
ys_c1, xs_c1 = np.where(mask_c1)
print('obs 30 Chair 1: bottom y =', ys_c1.max(), 'center x =', xs_c1.mean())
d_c1_30 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys_c1.max() - 255.5)
print(f'Chair 1 dist in obs 30: {d_c1_30:.2f} m')
x_c1 = -0.5 + (xs_c1.mean() - 255.5)/256 * d_c1_30
y_c1 = 3.3 + d_c1_30
print(f'Chair 1 world coords: x = {x_c1:.2f}, y = {y_c1:.2f}')

# Chair on the right (Chair 2):
mask_c2 = (img30[:,:,2] > 80) & (img30[:,:,2] < 150) & (img30[:,:,1] > 35) & (img30[:,:,1] < 80) & (img30[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 400)
ys_c2, xs_c2 = np.where(mask_c2)
print('obs 30 Chair 2: bottom y =', ys_c2.max(), 'center x =', xs_c2.mean())
d_c2_30 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys_c2.max() - 255.5)
print(f'Chair 2 dist in obs 30: {d_c2_30:.2f} m')
x_c2 = -0.5 + (xs_c2.mean() - 255.5)/256 * d_c2_30
y_c2 = 3.3 + d_c2_30
print(f'Chair 2 world coords: x = {x_c2:.2f}, y = {y_c2:.2f}')
"
